steps.title: Bem-vindo: Family - Volume 41
steps.text: In this C1-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Family". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

steps.text: It means: "To face a difficult situation with courage.". Say the example sentence out loud:
